component.name: ByeDPI
component.summary: Bypass deep packet inspection and censorship

description.p: ByeDPI is a Linux tool for circumventing deep packet inspection (DPI) based censorship, in the spirit of GoodbyeDPI for Windows. It intercepts your outgoing traffic with netfilter and applies a set of well-known evasion techniques so that filtering middleboxes fail to recognise and block the connection, while the destination server still receives a perfectly valid request.

ul.li: TCP fragmentation of the first data segment
Low-TTL fake packet injection to poison stateful DPI
HTTP Host header splitting across two segments
TLS ClientHello splitting at the SNI boundary
DNS interception and forwarding to an encrypted-friendly resolver

description.p: A clean GTK4 and libadwaita interface lets you toggle the bypass, choose a DNS resolver, tune techniques, watch a live packet log, and run from the system tray. A headless mode is available for servers and scripts.

ul.li: TCP fragmentation, fake low-TTL packets, HTTP and SNI splitting
DNS interception with upstream and fallback resolvers
GTK4 + libadwaita interface with a StatusNotifierItem tray
